title: LibreDWG safety proposal crosswalk
mode: Primary-source open PR and issue review plus local source/test-owner audit
scope: Review full bodies and diffs for LibreDWG PRs 1454, 1457, and 1458, and full issue bodies for 1450, 1451, and 1452.
Map integer arithmetic, C struct layout, JSON count/buffer, LTYPE, FIELD, and XDATA/EED findings to local owners and route applicability.
Refine implementation readiness without changing code, tests, fixtures, support claims, validation cadence, or implementation order.

sources.observed: The proposal reports count-times-maximum-element-width checks where multiplication occurs in 32-bit arithmetic before a later cast; its example wraps 21,916,000 * 196 to 568,704 instead of 4,295,536,000.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Open peer proposal and source-level repro description; not evidence of an analogous local defect or a format rule.

sources.observed: The proposal reports ASSOCASMBODYACTIONPARAM placing shared 3DSOLID fields at offsets inconsistent with shared helper casts, and proposes struct/dynapi ordering plus offset assertions. The PR describes ASan/UBSan/fuzzer evidence against its base.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer-specific C layout/alias contract. It does not by itself specify wire order or show a local failure; the corresponding class is absent from the local implementation.

sources.observed: The proposal reports count/buffer cardinality defects across LibreDWG's JSON importer, including section/object buffers, fixed vectors, shared array counts, subclass arrays, MLINE lines, and dotted keys into unset arrays.
sources.evidenceCeiling: JSON import route only. libdxfrw has no production JSON codec, so this is excluded from the local DXF/DWG route denominator.

sources.revision: Issue and official LTYPE reference reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: Issue #1450 reports LTYPE code 9 dash text without code 74. Autodesk documents text elements under the code 74 text flag; the reduced case is malformed-input safety evidence rather than a valid-file parity witness.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer report plus format reference. Existing local generated LTYPE controls cover valid flagged text, missing-flag refusal, bounds, and following-record alignment; no local defect is asserted.

sources.revision: Issue and official FIELD reference reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: Issue #1451 reports group 93=0 with a primary ACFD_FIELD_VALUE and stale pointer use in LibreDWG. The FIELD reference defines the group as a dataset count and does not specify a positive minimum.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Existing local generated AC1015 ASCII/Binary and AC1018 vectors cover zero child values, primary value retention, and following-object continuity; no local ownership failure is asserted.

sources.revision: Issue and ODA DWG specification v5.4.1 reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: Issue #1452 reports a packed-struct, odd-offset typed 16-bit access in LibreDWG's DXF-to-DWG EED encoder. ODA section 28 describes R2007+ EED string layout; the report concerns host-language alignment, not a different wire rule.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Local value-based dwgBuffer/dwgBufferW routes showed no analogous typed unaligned dereference in the scoped source review. This is not an exhaustive UB audit.

sources.observed: The local code contains checked uint64 multiply and subtraction-form range helpers used by several byte/bit bound paths; modeler carriers use DRW_ModelerGeometry callbacks; the reviewed peer associative type and JSON route are absent; generated LTYPE and FIELD zero-child controls already exist.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Scoped static crosswalk only, not an exhaustive arithmetic, aliasing, memory-safety, or feature-completeness audit.

assessment.planImpact: The research refines existing PAR-14, LTYPE, FIELD, EED/XDATA, and typed-modeler owner checks. It adds no code or test work; implementation remains local and the reduced fast-test cadence is unchanged.
